findings.issue: 'Feeding Grounds' is frozen as مَرتَع, bare. الافتراس ('predation') is added content the English does not carry, and it makes the location name diverge from the frozen term used elsewhere.
Second occurrence of the Conqueror name split: this location and the Tarstone 'Conqueror's Reward' use الفاتح, while Dialogue_Dlg_ConquerorBossDefeated calls the same boss الغازي. Pick one and sweep.
المُريد is frozen as Acolyte — Tiel's title. Using it for the generic 'disciple' collides with a named character's title. Franz's dialogue has the same collision ('You're not a disciple').
The glossary separates Obsidian = السَّبَج from Obsidianite = حجر السَّبَج. As written this reads 'Obsidian Mines' and loses the material the mines actually yield.
'Slums' is dropped; the Arabic says only 'the deserted quarters'. The poverty of the district is the descriptive content of the name.
المُشعوذ is a charlatan/quack. 'Illusionist' is one who works illusions, and the neighbouring dungeon 'Hall of Illusions' already uses الأوهام — the two should share the root.
